name: dust-creek
description: A choose-your-own-adventure western, every picture drawn in code with anidoodle.

scripts.covers: node tools/still.mjs p01 --shot loop --scale 0.5 --out out/cover-dust-creek.png && node tools/still.mjs c01 --shot loop --scale 0.5 --out out/cover-corbenic.png && for b in dust-creek corbenic; do sips -s format jpeg -s formatOptions 82 out/cover-$b.png --out www/covers/$b.jpg >/dev/null; done
